prompts.name: Caldera Tyrant — Elite Fire Dragon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW full-body elite FIRE DRAGON for Runelord, using the supplied approved Ashfall Wyrm artwork strictly as the 2D cel-shaded rendering reference. New silhouette: an enormous ancient quadrupedal dragon with a deep barrel chest, thick load-bearing legs, a long powerful neck, wedge-shaped stern head and swept basalt crown horns. Two gigantic high-arched wings with broad oxblood membranes, partly opened in a regal neutral combat stance; complete wings and tail within frame with generous padding. Four distinct grounded legs plus two wings, facing LEFT in shallow three-quarter side view. Charcoal basalt armor-like scale GROUPS, muted dark red underside, large clean orange furnace throat and a few ember crest plates; do not draw individual tiny scales. Make its monumental mass and ancient authority exceed an ordinary dragon; no scenery or other figures. Use the supplied approved Runelord artwork as a reference for simplified 2D shapes and cel-shaded rendering. Serious threatening expression, tough stylized silhouette, broad clean color shapes, crisp edges and hard-edged cel shadows, 2-3 tones per material, quiet surfaces. Slightly more designed detail but no texture noise, painterly rendering, realistic muscles, 3D/PBR lighting, bloom or haze. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no floor, no fog, no shadow puddle, no text, no border. HD clean source illustration, not a rig or sprite sheet.

prompts.name: Pyre Sovereign — Greater Arch-Demon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW full-body GREATER ARCH-DEMON elite fire monster for Runelord. Supplied approved Ignivar is only a cel-shaded style reference, do not copy its imp-like face or proportions. Monumental towering infernal monarch, huge broad armored shoulders and chest, thick legs, two muscular stylized arms, two enormous swept wings partly folded behind like a mantle. Six thick crown horns forming a clear regal silhouette, stern long angular face with small narrow molten eyes, closed cruel jaw, no cute grin. Obsidian plate armor over oxblood flesh, large bronze-edged shoulder plates, one simple glowing ember sigil on breastplate, restrained angular flame rising between crown horns. A massive broad execution sword in one hand angled down and outward with clear separation from leg; free claw hand held forward. Stable neutral combat stance facing LEFT in shallow three-quarter game view, two feet planted, all limbs, wing tips, horn tips and sword visible with ample transparent padding. Make it feel much larger and higher-ranking than normal demons through mass, posture and silhouette. Serious Runelord simplified 2D broad color shapes with hard-edged cel shadows, 2-3 tones per material, muted charcoal and oxblood with selective orange-gold accents. Sparse large armor chips, quiet surfaces. Avoid realistic anatomy, tiny ornament clutter, painterly rendering, gradients, PBR, 3D render, atmospheric bloom, background, ground plane, detached effects, text. Genuine transparent alpha. One clean concept master, no panels.

prompts.name: Furnace Colossus — Armored Flame Cyclops
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW full-body ARMORED FLAME CYCLOPS elite fire monster for Runelord. Use supplied approved Crucible Sentinel ONLY for cel-shaded style and weighty armor language. This subject is a LIVING ONE-EYED GIANT, not an automaton. Huge barrel torso, thick neck, broad stern heavy-jawed face with exactly ONE large central glowing amber eye, no second eye or eye sockets, exposed ochre/brick-red skin around face and arms, angular short flame crest. Monumental asymmetrical black iron armor, a massive layered near pauldron, broad copper-edged breastplate, segmented fauld and heavy greaves with visible knee joints, a few large orange vents. One gigantic long-handled forge maul held in its near hand, hammer head grounded beside the body; far fist visible clear of torso. Flat feet planted apart, neutral braced combat stance facing LEFT in shallow three-quarter view. Full complete character and weapon with ample padding on genuinely transparent background. Epic siege-breaker scale shown through huge armor mass and oversized forge hammer while keeping face, one eye, joint separations and silhouette readable at small game size. Broad flat clean color shapes, crisp edges, strong hard-edged cel shadows and restrained graphic highlights, 2-3 tones per material. Selective big notches only. No realistic muscles, pores, dense scratches, individual tiny detail, painterly texture, PBR shine, 3D, cinematic glow or haze. No environment, floor, text or border. Single 2D concept master.

repairs.dragonRepair: Edit the supplied dragon concept. Preserve this exact elite dragon identity and crisp angular 2D cel-shaded style, palette and four legs/two wings. Remove ALL hazy backdrop and atmospheric aura so that every pixel outside the actual dragon silhouette is genuinely transparent alpha, including holes between legs, tail and wings. No fog, cast shadow or background color. Reframe smaller to leave 8 percent empty transparent margin on EVERY side, with every horn, claw, wing tip and tail fully inside. Raise its neck and head slightly for a more monumental proud adult silhouette. Do not add text or panels. Keep broad clean graphic planes, no texture noise or gradients.
repairs.dragonExtraction: Background extraction edit ONLY. Cut out this exact dragon. DELETE the entire smoky gray/brown/red background and all glow outside the body. Output a PNG with ALPHA=0 in all background pixels, including between the legs, around the tail and wings. Preserve opaque dragon artwork. No substitute backdrop, no black rectangle, no fog, no halo. Keep exact body and graphic cel shading; do not repaint the creature. Fit entire dragon inside canvas with generous transparent padding.
